Title: Simulation and optimization of nutrient uptake and biomass formation using a multi-parameter Monod-type model of tobacco BY-2 cell suspension cultures in a stirred-tank bioreactor

Abstract: Results and discussion: The biomass formation was well predicted by an unstructured segregated mechanistic Monod-type model as long as the nutrient concentrations did not approach zero (we omitted phosphate, which was completely depleted). Model: improved unstructured model with sucrose hydrolysis
Laws:
(2) [balance] Active-cell dry-mass balance accounting for growth and conversion to dead cells.
(3) [balance] Cultivation-medium volume accumulation equals the feed rate.
(5) [balance] Sucrose concentration balance including sucrose feed and active-biomass-associated consumption.
(6) [balance] Nitrate concentration balance including nitrate feed and active-biomass-associated consumption.
(7) [balance] Ammonium concentration balance including ammonium feed and active-biomass-associated consumption.
(8) [balance] Phosphate concentration balance including feed input and concentration-dependent uptake without an active-biomass factor.
(18) [constitutive] Specific cell growth rate as a nutrient-dependent maximum rate multiplied by glucose, fructose, and nitrate saturation–inhibition factors.
(19) [balance] Fructose mass balance in the cultivation medium, with fructose produced through sucrose hydrolysis and consumed by cells.
(20) [balance] Glucose mass balance in the cultivation medium, with glucose produced through sucrose hydrolysis and consumed by cells.

States (computed by the ODEs):
- V: Volume of the cultivation medium
- X_{a}: Active (viable) cell dry mass
- S: Sucrose concentration
- N: nitrate concentration
- A: ammonium concentration
- P: Phosphate concentration.
- F: Fructose
- G: Glucose concentration.

Inputs (variables no law computes):
- F_{t}: Feed rate at time point t
- S_{f}: Feed-medium sucrose concentration
- N_{f}: feed-medium nitrate concentration
- A_{f}: feed-medium ammonium concentration
- P_{f}: Phosphate concentration in the feed medium.

Model-wide assumptions:
- The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).

answer.description: The model describes tobacco BY-2 cell suspension cultivation in a stirred-tank bioreactor and predicts active biomass and culture-medium nutrient concentrations. It combines nutrient-dependent Monod-type growth and active-to-dead cell conversion with nutrient uptake and sucrose hydrolysis to glucose and fructose. Feed inputs and changing culture volume are included, but the supplied text does not specify the operating mode.
